property_summary: For every caller address, calling setOwner(...) on the reference either reverts for non-admins and returns true for the admin; the mutant allows non-admin calls to succeed and return true, so there exists some caller (any non-admin) and owner argument where reference reverts but mutant returns true.
change_summary: Modify onlyAdmin's require to allow anyone (remove msg.sender check) by requiring true, which permits calls to proceed and thus lets setOwner run when called by non-admins, but keeps setOwner's return value unchanged for admin calls — however for calls by non-admins the call will now complete and return true (different observable behavior for some callers).
